stories.title: Hoosier, 97, has connection to history-making SS United States
stories.summary: Seventy-four years before the ship was sunk to become the world's largest artificial reef, it set a transatlantic speed record that still stands today.

stories.title: IPS proposes closing 6 school buildings, merging several schools in restructuring plan
stories.summary: District leaders said the proposal would save about $4 million while addressing declining enrollment and ongoing financial challenges.

stories.title: Garten files for recount after Indiana Supreme Court clears the way for him to take office
stories.summary: The Indiana Supreme Court allowed Garten to take office, but stopped short of certifying the results of his election.

stories.title: As construction continues on IndyGo Blue Line project, business owners ask for better communication
stories.summary: IndyGo Blue Line project between Cumberland and Indianapolis International Airport is expected to wrap up in 2028.

stories.title: Amid increased flu activity, Marion County hospitals to begin temporary visitor restrictions
stories.summary: On Nov. 19, hospitals will begin temporary restrictions the include mandatory masks and no visitors under 18 years old.

stories.title: Clear Path 465 | Weekend traffic disruptions expected as project's final two ramps open this weekend on Indy's northeast side
stories.summary: As the completion of the Clear Path 465 project nears, INDOT is announcing changes in traffic patterns this weekend.

stories.title: Fishers police arrest man accused in I-69 road rage shooting
stories.summary: An Indianapolis man is accused of firing shots into another vehicle during a road rage incident on I-69 in Fishers.

stories.title: 'I didn’t [know] the gun wasn’t on safe' | 17-year-old boy arrested after allegedly killing 13-year-old girl at northeast Indy apartment complex
stories.summary: The shooting was reported around 4 a.m. Oct. 24 in the 3600 block of Bunker Hill Drive, which is near 42nd Street and North Sherman Drive.

stories.title: 'Create new pathways into the U.S. Armed Forces' | Gov. Braun introduces first ever high school military-to-college pathway program
stories.summary: The program is called the Enlisted Training Corps (ETC). It is a pilot program at Monroe Central Junior-Senior High School with 11 students currently participating.

stories.title: Hendricks County Animal Shelter waiving all adoption fees for dogs after reaching full capacity
stories.summary: The HCAS is hoping its dogs can find loving homes fast so that it can take in more pups in need.

stories.title: Indiana State Police K-9 to receive body armor from national nonprofit
stories.summary: Bosco's vest was sponsored by Vested Interest in K9s, Inc. and will be embroidered with the sentiment “In honor of Sergeant Dennis Wade."

stories.title: 20-year-old man airlifted to hospital after suspected drunk driving crash in Parke County
stories.summary: According to the Parke County Sheriff's Department, the pickup truck ran off the road, clipped a parked vehicle and hit a tree in someone's front yard.
